title: JyGlobalVST Update Manifest
description: Response body returned by the configured update-check HTTPS endpoint (FR-022n). The request is a single HTTPS GET initiated only by explicit user action; no identifying payload is sent. The response MUST be a JSON document conforming to this schema.

latest_version.description: Semantic version of the latest available release.

minimum_supported.description: Optional. If the installed version is below this, the UI MAY display a stronger 'please update' message.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL of the .msi/.msix installer. User MUST click to download (FR-022o).

x-client-rules: FR-022n: client MUST NOT send any identifying headers, query strings, or body. A plain HTTPS GET with default platform User-Agent only.
FR-022n: client MUST NOT poll on launch or on a timer; only on explicit 'Check for updates…' invocation.
FR-022o: the MSI/MSIX download and install MUST remain explicit user actions.
Failures (offline, DNS, TLS, 4xx/5xx) surface only as in-session UI notifications — no disk log (FR-022n).
